name: Microsoft Exchange Trace Logs - Message Monitoring
description: This Dashboard mainly focuses on the message traffic i.e. gives the count of unique senders, receivers and respective unique domains. It provides the geo location of senders, receivers and the messages which are failed. It also does the threat detection analysis of senders for security.
title: Microsoft Exchange Trace Logs - Message Monitoring

panels.title: Geo Location of Senders

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MessageExchangeTraceLogs 
| json "Organization", "MessageId", "Received","SenderAddress", "RecipientAddress", "Subject", "Status", "ToIP", "FromIP", "Size", "MessageTraceId", "StartDate", "EndDate", "Index" as organization, message_id, received, sender_address, recipient_address, subject, status, toIP, fromIP, size, message_traceId, start_date, end_Date, index nodrop
| where status matches"{{status}}"
| where sender_address matches"{{sender_address}}"
| where organization matches "{{organization}}"
| where isValidIP(fromIP) and !isPrivateIP(fromIP)
| count as IPCount by fromIP
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = fromIP
| where country_name matches "{{country}}"

panels.title: Threat Intel Analysis of Senders Email Address

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MessageExchangeTraceLogs 
| json "Organization", "MessageId", "Received","SenderAddress", "RecipientAddress", "Subject", "Status", "ToIP", "FromIP", "Size", "MessageTraceId", "StartDate", "EndDate", "Index" as organization, message_id, received, sender_address, recipient_address, subject, status, toIP, fromIP, size, message_traceId, start_date, end_Date, index nodrop
| where status matches"{{status}}"
| where sender_address matches"{{sender_address}}"
| where organization matches "{{organization}}"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = fromIP
| where country_name matches "{{country}}"
| count as email_count by sender_address, _source
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=sender_address
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name 
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| where type="email_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as Actor
|sum (email_count) as threat_count by sender_address, malicious_confidence, Actor,  _source, label_name
| sort by threat_count
